title: Culture Cartography: Mapping the Landscape of Cultural Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the recall rate (Recall@K) of large language models on a dataset of culturally salient and challenging knowledge from under-represented cultures (Nigerian and Indonesian), elicited via a mixed-initiative human-AI tool (Culture Explorer), and evaluating downstream performance on culturally-aware NLP benchmarks (BLEnD and CulturalBench).
